def make_transform():
    def transform(grid):
        H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
        vals = {}
        for r in grid:
            for v in r:
                if v: vals[v] = vals.get(v, 0) + 1
        inner_c = min(vals, key=vals.get)
        outer_c = max(vals, key=vals.get)
        pts_in = [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if grid[i][j]==inner_c]
        pts_out = [(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if grid[i][j]==outer_c]
        ri = [p[0] for p in pts_in]; ci=[p[1] for p in pts_in]
        ro = [p[0] for p in pts_out]; co=[p[1] for p in pts_out]
        t = max(1, inner_c // 2)
        out = [[inner_c]*W for _ in range(H)]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if not (min(ro)-t <= i <= max(ro)+t and min(co)-t <= j <= max(co)+t):
                    out[i][j] = 0
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                if grid[i][j]:
                    out[i][j] = grid[i][j]
        return out
